intents.name: packages
intents.answer:
🎒 *Wanderly Tour Packages — What's Included*

✅ *Included in Every Package:*
• Quality hotel/resort/houseboat accommodation
• Daily breakfast (half-board on request)
• Complete transfers & guided sightseeing
• On-trip coordinator & 24x7 emergency helpline

❌ *Usually Excluded:*
• International/domestic flights, visa fees, and personal expenses.

intents.name: booking_policy
intents.answer:
📋 *Wanderly Travel — Booking & Cancellation Policy*

• *Advance:* 30% advance payment to confirm your booking.
• *Full Payment:* Due 15 days before departure date.
• *Date Changes:* Free date change up to 21 days before departure.
• *Cancellations:*
  - 30+ days before travel: 90% refund
  - 15–29 days before travel: 50% refund
  - Within 14 days of travel: Non-refundable

intents.name: visa_documents
intents.answer:
🛂 *Visa & Documentation Support*

• *Assistance:* End-to-end guidance for Dubai, Thailand, Bali, Singapore & Schengen Europe visas.
• *Requirements:* Passport with 6+ months validity, photos, 6-month bank statements, and employment proof.
• *Turnaround:* Typically 5–15 working days depending on destination.
• *Domestic Tours:* Carry any government photo ID.
